content.title: Live Blog: Real Madrid vs Girona LIVE score and updates
content.text: Real Madrid is held to a 1–1 draw by Girona, and Barcelona could open up a 9-point lead by the end of the matchday.The Frenchman had a chance to make it 2-1, but he shot straight at the goalkeeper.62' Lemar finds space—taking advantage of Camavinga's lax defending—and scores a stunner to equalize.50' Fede Valverde unleashed a rocket; goalkeeper Gazzaniga blunders, conceding the 1-0 goal against Girona.Fede Valverde aimed for the top corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga pulled off a spectacular save.Madrid enter the match with one eye on their Champions League quarterfinal second leg against Bayern Munich, where they need a comeback.However, they cannot afford to drop points in LaLiga.Girona, led by Míchel, arrive looking to secure survival and cause problems at the Bernabéu.Arbeloa is expected to rotate, resting players like Rüdiger, Carreras and Alexander-Arnold ahead of the Champions League clash.
